blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang has already left the country through the “backdoor,” Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla confirmed on Tuesday. “He used the backdoor,” Remulla said in a chance interview on the sidelines of the 20th ASEAN Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime in Makati City on Tuesday.
